headline: GOLD MINERS DETONATE: GDX Rockets 8%, GDXJ +9% — Both at 52-Week Highs as Iran Fears Ease
snippet: Gold and silver mining ETFs staged their biggest single-day rally in months Wednesday, with GDX climbing 8% to $92.67 and GDXJ jumping 9% to $123.50, both hitting 52-week highs as reports of a potential U.S.-Iran ceasefire sent oil plunging 7% and redirected capital into precious metals equities. GDX has now gained more than 72% over the past 52 weeks.

headline: PROJECT FREEDOM FADES: Gold Rebounds to $4,711, Silver Surges 6% to $77/oz Wednesday
snippet: Gold climbed above $4,700 for the first time this week — erasing Monday's dip on Trump's 'Project Freedom' Strait of Hormuz corridor plan — while silver surged 6.01% to $77.18/oz, now up more than 150% year-over-year. The SLV ETF jumped more than 6% as institutional safe-haven demand held firm despite easing geopolitical noise.

headline: BONANZA IN NEVADA: Scorpio Gold (CVE: SGN) Hits 455 g/t Core in Zanzibar Trend Step-Out
snippet: Hole 26MN-067 at the Manhattan District, Nevada returned 10.40 g/t Au over 5.67m including a bonanza interval of 455.52 g/t over 0.49m — Phase Two step-out drilling has now returned assays on 58 of 76 holes totalling 18,668m with 18 holes still pending. Shares jumped 8.6% on the news.

headline: Mako Mining (CVE: MKO) Hits 26.98 g/t Au Over 6.8m at Las Conchitas — Permitted Zone Grows to 450m Strike
snippet: Mako Mining expanded its Las Conchitas target south of the producing San Albino gold mine in Nicaragua, intersecting 26.98 g/t Au over 6.8m true width with multiple 100 g/t-metre intervals over 450m of continuous permitted strike. CEO Akiba Leisman called it among the most significant exploration results in the project's six-year mining history.

headline: Contango Ore Acquires 100% of Lucky Shot Lease for $16.1M — Drill Hits Confirm High-Grade Alaska Gold
snippet: Contango Ore entered a purchase agreement to acquire 100% of the Lucky Shot project in Alaska from Alaska Hardrock Inc. for $16.1M, extinguishing a 2% NSR royalty, while simultaneously reporting high-grade Phase III underground drill results. The deal consolidates full ownership ahead of a planned Direct Shipping Ore gold mine 112 road miles north of Anchorage.

headline: American Pacific Mining Launches Largest-Ever 15,000m Drill Campaign at Madison Copper-Gold
snippet: American Pacific Mining has contracted two Montana-based drilling companies to run a fully funded 15,000m combined RC and diamond program at its Madison copper-gold porphyry project, with the first rig mobilizing this month. The program — the company's largest to date — targets both shallow high-grade extensions and deeper porphyry discovery holes.

headline: Purepoint Uranium (TSX-V: PTU) Sharpens Athabasca Drill Targets With Integrated 3D Models Ahead of June Campaign
snippet: Purepoint Uranium is combining airborne MobileMT surveys with advanced 3D structural modelling to rank subsurface targets across its Athabasca Basin portfolio ahead of a June 2026 drill campaign. The Athabasca Basin remains the world's highest-grade uranium district as spot prices hold above $100/lb and AI-driven utility demand accelerates.

headline: CHINA SILVER BINGE: 836 Tonnes Imported in March Alone as Solar Demand Overwhelms Global Supply
snippet: China's silver imports hit an all-time monthly record of 836 tonnes in March, driven by surging solar panel manufacturing and renewed retail investment demand — a pace the world's mining sector cannot match. The same weekly SWOT analysis notes the People's Bank of China made its 17th consecutive gold purchase in March, adding five tonnes to reach 2,313 tonnes.

headline: Charts Flash Green: Technical Analyst Maps Gold's Next Move After $4,700 Weekly Close
snippet: Northstar & Badcharts' May 5 weekly gold and silver technical update examines chart structure around the $4,500-4,700 zone and what Wednesday's breakout above $4,700 means for near-term price targets. Silver's relative strength versus gold is flagged as a key confirmation signal for the ongoing precious metals bull market.
